verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በገዳም ፡ ዘሲና ፡ በካልእት ፡ ዓመት ፡ እምዘ ፡ ወጽኡ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡
                  በቀዳሚ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina in the second year after they had gone forth from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina in the second year after they had gone forth from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
translations.ron: În vremea aceea a grăit Domnul cu Moise în pustiul Sinai, în anul al doilea după ieşirea din Egipt, în luna întâi, şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινᾷ ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ, ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ, λέγων,

verses.geez: ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ፋሲካ ፡ አመ ፡ ጊዜሁ ።
verses.translation: Speak, and let the children of Israel keep the passover in its season.

translations.lxx: Speak, and let the children of Israel keep the passover in its season.
translations.kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
translations.ron: "Spune fiilor lui Israel să facă Paştile la vremea rânduită pentru ele:
translations.grk: εἶπον, καὶ ποιείτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὸ πάσχα καθʼ ὥραν αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez:
አመ ፡ ዐሡሩ ፡ ወረቡዑ ፡ ለሠርቀ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ቀዳሚ ፡ ወፍና ፡ ሰርክ ፡ ትገብርዎ ፡ አመ ፡ ጊዜሁ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ሕጉ ፡
                  ወበከመ ፡ ትእዛዙ ፡ ትገብሮ ።
verses.translation: On the fourteenth day of the first month at even, thou shalt keep it in its season; thou shalt keep it according to its law, and according to its ordinance.

translations.lxx: On the fourteenth day of the first month at even, thou shalt keep it in its season; thou shalt keep it according to its law, and according to its ordinance.
translations.kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
translations.ron: În ziua de paisprezece a lunii întâi, spre seară, să le facă la vremea lor, după legea lor şi după regulile lor să le săvârşiţi".
translations.grk: τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου πρὸς ἑσπέραν, ποιήσεις αὐτὸ κατὰ καιρούς· κατὰ τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ποιήσεις αὐτό.

verses.geez: ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ፋሲካ ።
verses.translation: And Moses ordered the children of Israel to sacrifice the passover,

translations.lxx: And Moses ordered the children of Israel to sacrifice the passover,
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
translations.ron: Şi a spus Moise fiilor lui Israel să facă Paştile:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ποιῆσαι τὸ πάσχα ἐναρχομένου τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ Σινᾶ.

verses.geez:
ወይእኅዙ ፡ እምዕለተ ፡ ዐሡሩ ፡ ወረቡዑ ፡ ለሠርቀ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ በገዳም ፡ ዘሲና ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ለሙሴ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: on the fourteenth day of the first month in the wilderness of Sina, as the Lord appointed Moses, so the children of Israel did.

translations.lxx: on the fourteenth day of the first month in the wilderness of Sina, as the Lord appointed Moses, so the children of Israel did.
translations.kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut ei Paştile în luna întâi, în ziua a paisprezecea, spre seară, în pustiul Sinai; cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise aşa au făcut fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ, οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወመጽኡ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እለ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ርኵስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ ወስእኑ ፡ ገቢረ ፡ ፋሲካ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወመጽኡ
                  ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And there came men who were unclean by reason of a dead body, and they were not able to keep the passover on that day; and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

translations.lxx: And there came men who were unclean by reason of a dead body, and they were not able to keep the passover on that day; and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.
translations.kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
translations.ron: Dar erau şi oameni necuraţi, care se atinseseră de trup de om mort, şi nu puteau să săvârşească Paştile în ziua aceea. Aceştia au venit în ziua aceea la Moise şi Aaron,
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεγένοντο οἱ ἄνδρες οἳ ἦσαν ἀκάθαρτοι ἐπὶ ψυχῇ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο ποιῆσαι τὸ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ· καὶ προσῆλθον ἐναντίον Μωυσῆ καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ·

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ውእቶሙ ፡ ዕደው ፡ ንሕነሰ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ እለ ፡ ብነ ፡ ርኵስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነፍስነ ፡ ወኢንትኀደግ ፡
                  እምአብኦ ፡ ቍርባኑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በበዘመኑ ።
verses.translation: And those men said to Moses, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: shall we therefore fail to offer the gift to the Lord in its season in the midst of the children of Israel?

translations.lxx: And those men said to Moses, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: shall we therefore fail to offer the gift to the Lord in its season in the midst of the children of Israel?
translations.kjv: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
translations.ron: Şi le-au spus oamenii aceia: "Noi suntem necuraţi, pentru că ne-am atins de trup de om mort; do ce să nu fim lăsaţi să aducem Domnului dar la vremea cea rânduită pentru fiii lui Israel?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄνδρες ἐκεῖνοι πρὸς αὐτὸν, ἡμεῖς ἀκάθαρτοι ἐπὶ ψυχῇ ἀνθρώπου· μὴ οὖν ὑστερήσωμεν προσενέγκαι τὸ δῶρον Κυρίῳ κατὰ καιρὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቁሙኒ ፡ ወእስማዕ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ይኤዝዝ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንቲአክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to them, Stand there, and I will hear what charge the Lord will give concerning you.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to them, Stand there, and I will hear what charge the Lord will give concerning you.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
translations.ron: Iar Moise a zis către ei: "Staţi aici, că am să ascult ce porunceşte Domnul pentru voi!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς, στῆτε αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀκούσομαι τί ἐντελεῖται Κύριος περὶ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: A grăit Domnul lui Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ለእመቦ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ ርኵስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡
                  ወለእመኒ ፡ ርሑቀ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ወለእመኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሙላዲክሙ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ፋሲካሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፤
verses.translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Whatever man shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or on a journey far off, among you, or among your posterity; he shall then keep the passover to the Lord,

translations.lxx: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Whatever man shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or on a journey far off, among you, or among your posterity; he shall then keep the passover to the Lord,
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
translations.ron: "Spune fiilor lui Israel: Dacă cineva din voi sau din urmaşii voştri va fi necurat prin atingere de trup de om mort, sau va fi departe în călătorie, sau între neamuri străine, şi acela să facă Paştile Domnului.
translations.grk: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, λέγων, ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος, ὃν ἐὰν γένηται ἀκάθαρτος ἐπὶ ψυχῇ, ἀνθρώπου, ἢ ἐν ὁδῷ μακρὰν ὑμῖν, ἢ ἐν ταῖς γενεαῖς ὑμῶν, καὶ ποιήσει τὸ πάσχα Κυρίῳ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐν τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ·

verses.geez:
በካልእ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ አመ ፡ ዐሡሩ ፡ ወረቡዑ ፡ ለሠርቅ ፡ ፍና ፡ ሰርክ ፡ ይግበርዎ ፡ በናእት ፡ ወኀምለ ፡ ብሒእ ፡
                  ይብልዕዎ ።
verses.translation: in the second month, on the fourteenth day; in the evening they shall offer it, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs shall they eat it.

translations.lxx: in the second month, on the fourteenth day; in the evening they shall offer it, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs shall they eat it.
translations.kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
translations.ron: Dar să le facă în ziua a paisprezecea a lunii a doua, seara, şi să le mănânce cu azime şi cu ierburi amare;
translations.grk: τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν ποιήσουσιν αὐτὸ, ἐπʼ ἀζύμων καὶ πικρίδων φάγονται αὐτό.

verses.geez: ወኢያትርፉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ለነግህ ፡ ወዐጽመ ፡ ኢይስብሩ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ በሕጉ ፡ ለፋሲካ ፡ ይግበርዎ ።
verses.translation: They shall not leave of it until the morrow, and they shall not break a bone of it; they shall sacrifice it according to the ordinance of the passover.

translations.lxx: They shall not leave of it until the morrow, and they shall not break a bone of it; they shall sacrifice it according to the ordinance of the passover.
translations.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
translations.ron: Să nu lase din ele pe a doua zi, nici oasele să nu le zdrobească; şi să le săvârşească după toată rânduiala Paştilor.
translations.grk: Οὐ καταλείψουσιν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πρωῒ, καὶ ὀστοῦν οὐ συντρίψουσιν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ· κατὰ τὸν νόμον τοῦ πάσχα ποιήσουσιν αὐτό.

verses.geez:
ወሰብእሰ ፡ ዘንጹሕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ ርሑቀ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኀደገ ፡ ገቢረ ፡ ፋሲካ ፡ ለትሠሮ
                  ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሕዝባ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢያብአ ፡ በዘመኑ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ይከውኖ ፡ ለውእቱ
                  ፡ ብእሲ ።
verses.translation: And whatsoever man shall be clean, and is not far off on a journey, and shall fail to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people, because he has not offered the gift to the Lord in its season: that man shall bear his iniquity.

translations.lxx: And whatsoever man shall be clean, and is not far off on a journey, and shall fail to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people, because he has not offered the gift to the Lord in its season: that man shall bear his iniquity.
translations.kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
translations.ron: Iar omul curat, care nu se află departe în călătorie şi nu va face Paştile, sufletul acela să se stârpească din poporul său, că n-a adus dar Domnului la vreme. Omul acela îşi va purta păcatul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν καθαρὸς ᾖ, καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ μακρὰν οὐκ ἔστι, καὶ ὑστερήσῃ ποιῆσαι τὸ πάσχα, ἐξολοθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς, ὅτι τὸ δῶρον Κυρίῳ οὐ προσήνεγκε κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν αὐτοῦ· ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῦ λήψεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ኀቤክሙ ፡ ግዩር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ፋሲካሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በሕጉ ፡ ለፋሱካ ፡
                  ወበከመ ፡ ትእዛዙ ፡ ይግበርዎ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ለግዩርኒ ፡ ወለዘ ፡ እምፍጥረቱኒ ።
verses.translation: And if there should come to you a stranger in your land, and should keep the passover to the Lord, he shall keep it according to the law of the passover and according to its ordinance: there shall be one law for you, both for the stranger, and for the native of the land.

translations.lxx: And if there should come to you a stranger in your land, and should keep the passover to the Lord, he shall keep it according to the law of the passover and according to its ordinance: there shall be one law for you, both for the stranger, and for the native of the land.
translations.kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
translations.ron: De va trăi la voi vreun străin să facă şi el Paştile Domnului: după legea Paştilor şl după rânduiala lor să le facă. O singură lege să fie şi pentru voi şi pentru străin".
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ προσέλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς προσήλυτος ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν, καὶ ποιήσῃ τὸ πάσχα Κυρίῳ, κατὰ τὸν νόμον τοῦ πάσχα, καὶ κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν αὐτοῦ ποιήσει αὐτό· νόμος εἷς ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ αὐτόχθονι τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወበዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ተከልዋ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ከደና ፡ ደመና ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ መርጡል ፡ ወሌሊተሰ ፡ ይመጽእ
                  ፡ ዲበ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ከመ ፡ ራእየ ፡ እሳት ፡ እስከ ፡ ይጸብሕ ።
verses.translation: And in the day in which the tabernacle was pitched the cloud covered the tabernacle, the place of the testimony; and in the evening there was upon the tabernacle as the appearance of fire till the morning.

translations.lxx: And in the day in which the tabernacle was pitched the cloud covered the tabernacle, the place of the testimony; and in the evening there was upon the tabernacle as the appearance of fire till the morning.
translations.kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
translations.ron: În ziua când a fost aşezat cortul, nor a acoperit cortul adunării, şi de seara până dimineaţa a fost deasupra cortului, ca o vedere de foc.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐστάθη ἡ σκηνὴ, ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφελη τὴν σκηνὴν, τὸν οἶκον τοῦ μαρτυρίου· καὶ τὸ ἑσπέρας ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ὡς εἶδος πυρὸς ἕως πρωΐ.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ለዘልፍ ፡ ደመና ፡ ይከድና ፡ መዓልተ ፡ ወራእየ ፡ እሳት ፡ ሌሊተ ።
verses.translation: So it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

translations.lxx: So it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
translations.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
translations.ron: Aşa era totdeauna: ziua îl acoperea un nor şi noaptea o vedere de foc.
translations.grk: Οὕτως ἐγίνετο διαπαντός· ἡ νεφέλη ἐκάλυπτεν αὐτὴν ἡμέρας, καὶ εἶδος πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα.

verses.geez:
ወእምከመ ፡ ሰሰለ ፡ ደመና ፡ እምነ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይግዕዙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወመካኖ ፡ ኀበ ፡
                  ቆመ ፡ ደመና ፡ ህየ ፡ ይትዐየኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And when the cloud went up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel departed; and in whatever place the cloud rested, there the children of Israel encamped.

translations.lxx: And when the cloud went up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel departed; and in whatever place the cloud rested, there the children of Israel encamped.
translations.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
translations.ron: Când se ridica norul de deasupra cortului, atunci fiii lui Israel plecau şi în locul unde se oprea norul, acolo poposeau cu tabăra fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡνίκα ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῇραν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἂν ἔστη ἡ νεφέλη, ἐκεῖ παρενέβαλον οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወበትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይግዕዙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ ይጼልላ ፡ ደመና ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ዘየሐድሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡
                  እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: The children of Israel shall encamp by the command of the Lord, and by the command of the Lord they shall remove: all the days in which the cloud overshadows the tabernacle, the children of Israel shall encamp.

translations.lxx: The children of Israel shall encamp by the command of the Lord, and by the command of the Lord they shall remove: all the days in which the cloud overshadows the tabernacle, the children of Israel shall encamp.
translations.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
translations.ron: După porunca Domnului se opreau fiii lui Israel cu tabăra lor şi după porunca Domnului plecau; tot timpul cât norul stătea deasupra cortului, stăteau şi ei cu tabăra.
translations.grk: Διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἀπαροῦσι· πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν αἷς σκιάζει ἡ νεφέλη ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς, παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ደመና ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መዓቅቢሆሙ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢይግዕዙ ።
verses.translation: And whenever the cloud shall be drawn over the tabernacle for many days, then the children of Israel shall keep the charge of God, and they shall not remove.

translations.lxx: And whenever the cloud shall be drawn over the tabernacle for many days, then the children of Israel shall keep the charge of God, and they shall not remove.
translations.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
translations.ron: Când însă norul stătea multă vreme deasupra cortului, urmau acestui semn al Domnului şi fiii lui Israel şi nu plecau.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅταν ἐφέλκηται ἡ νεφέλη ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἡμέρας πλείους, καὶ φυλάξονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὴν φυλακὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξάρωσι.

verses.geez:
ወበኍልቈ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘይከድን ፡ ደመና ፡ ዲበ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ የኀድሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወበትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይግዕዙ ።
verses.translation: And it shall be, whenever the cloud overshadows the tabernacle a number of days, they shall encamp by the word of the Lord, and shall remove by the command of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And it shall be, whenever the cloud overshadows the tabernacle a number of days, they shall encamp by the word of the Lord, and shall remove by the command of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
translations.ron: Câteodată se întâmpla ca norul să stea numai puţină vreme deasupra cortului: după glasul Domnului se opreau şi după porunca Lui plecau la drum.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὅταν σκεπάζῃ ἡ νεφέλη ἡμέρας ἀριθμῷ ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς, διὰ φωνῆς Κυρίου παρεμβαλοῦσι, καὶ διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἀπαροῦσι.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ደመና ፡ እምሰርክ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነግህ ፡ ወእምከመ ፡ ጸብሐ ፡ ይሴስል ፡ ደመና ፡ ይግዕዙ ፡ መዓልተ ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, whenever the cloud shall remain from the evening till the morning, and in the morning the cloud shall go up, then shall they remove by day or by night.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass, whenever the cloud shall remain from the evening till the morning, and in the morning the cloud shall go up, then shall they remove by day or by night.
translations.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
translations.ron: Câteodată norul stătea numai de seara până dimineaţa, iar dimineaţa se ridica norul; atunci plecau şi ei; sau stătea norul o zi şi o noapte, şi când se ridica, plecau şi ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὅταν γένηται ἡ νεφέλη ἀφʼ ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωῒ, καὶ ἀναβῇ ἡ νεφέλη τοπρωῒ, καὶ ἀπαροῦσιν ἡμέρας ἢ νυκτός.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ አብዝኀ ፡ ነቢረ ፡ ደመና ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይጼልላ ፡ እስከ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ይትዓየኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል
                  ፡ ወኢይግዕዙ ።
verses.translation: When the cloud continues a full month overshadowing the tabernacle, the children of Israel shall encamp, and shall not depart.

translations.lxx: When the cloud continues a full month overshadowing the tabernacle, the children of Israel shall encamp, and shall not depart.
translations.kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
translations.ron: Sau de umbrea norul deasupra cortului două zile, sau o lună, sau un an, fiii lui Israel stăteau şi nu plecau la drum; iar când se ridica el, atunci plecau,
translations.grk: Μηνὸς ἡμέρας πλεοναζούσης τῆς νεφέλης σκιαζούσης ἐπʼ αὐτῆς, παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπάρωσιν.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይግዕዙ ፡ ወሕገጊሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወበእዴሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: For they shall depart by the command of the Lord:—they kept the charge of the Lord by the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

translations.lxx: For they shall depart by the command of the Lord:—they kept the charge of the Lord by the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
translations.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Că din porunca Domnului se opreau şi din porunca Domnului plecau la drum: urmau semnul Domnului, după porunca dată de Domnul prin Moise.
translations.grk: Ὅτι διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἀπαροῦσι· τὴν φυλακὴν Κυρίου ἐφυλάξαντο διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ.
